TEF Entrepreneurship Programme

The Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship Programme supports African entrepreneurs every year with training, mentorship and seed capital.

Successful applicants receive US$5,000 in non-refundable seed capital.

Apply on TEFConnect.

  • Applications from Africans who are 18 years and above.
  • Applicants who either have a business idea or have a business no older than 5 years.
